description: Get famous US average consumer prices in dollars from the BLS: eggs (per dozen), gasoline (per gallon), milk (per gallon), bread (per lb), ground-beef (per lb), coffee (per lb) and electricity (per kWh). Without "item" it returns the latest price of the whole basket. With "item" it returns that item's monthly history (gasoline since 1976), paginated by period range (use meta.next_end as the next "end").

end.description: Inclusive end month (YYYY-MM). Only used with "item"; pass meta.next_end to paginate.

item.description: One item for monthly history. Omit to get the latest price of every item.

limit.description: Max points per page (1-100, default 30). Only used with "item".

start.description: Inclusive start month (YYYY-MM). Only used with "item".

name: get_famous_prices
title: Famous US average prices (eggs, gasoline…)
